svg.title: Night 2: The Crossing
svg.desc: The second night's card: the shared fire ring burned down to embers with six seats round it, five of them used and one that nobody filled; a closed notebook lies on the stump nearest the coals, and there is no star in the sky. Beside the picture, the map's green legend box keeps its height with 3 of its nine rows printed; Tam's pencil count underneath agrees.
